note: Deterministic Go<->JS composite cross-verification fixtures (SHARED_CRYPTO_FOUNDATION.md). Both implementations derive the keypair from (mldsa_seed, ed_seed), sign the message bytes with the deterministic ML-DSA-65 external/empty-context interface plus Ed25519, and MUST reproduce composite_public_key and composite_signature byte-for-byte, then verify them. ML-DSA uses extraEntropy:false (JS) / SignTo randomized=false (Go). Seeds and messages are public test values, not secrets. All hex is lowercase; message is the raw signed bytes in hex.
